situation: I'm organising a surprise 40th for my friend Claire and just found out the restaurant we booked for 18 people cancelled on us, 9 days before. Need to tell the group chat.
reply: Bad news, everyone: Osteria Rosa cancelled our booking for the 17th this morning, they've had a flood in the kitchen. I know a few of you booked trains around it. The date stays the same; I've got holds at two other places near the station and I'll confirm one by Sunday. Still very much on.
note: News in the first line, one line of why, acknowledge the cost to them, then what happens next.

situation: 我是部门经理，公司今年冻结调薪，我得告诉组里的小陈，她之前一直在等这次涨薪，我也答应过帮她争取。打算先发消息约她聊。
reply: 小陈，有件事想直接跟你说，不太是好消息。今年公司冻结调薪，你的涨薪这次没有批下来。我知道你一直在等，我之前也跟你说过会争取，这个结果我很抱歉。明天上午10点我们当面聊一下，我想跟你一起定一个明年上半年的具体目标，到时候我拿着它再去提。
note: 消息放在前两句，不用模糊的'可能有点难'。当面聊比文字好，所以消息里先说清楚，再约时间。

situation: Freelance dev. I found out the payment integration I promised a client for their Nov 1 launch can't be done with their current payment provider. Need to email the client, Rachel.
reply:
Hi Rachel,
I'll get straight to it: Apple Pay can't be added on your current Paymark plan, so it won't be in the 1 November launch. I checked with their support this morning and it's only available on their enterprise tier. I know that was one of the features you wanted for the holiday rush. Two options: launch on the 1st with cards and PayPal, or I can set up Stripe alongside Paymark, which adds about a week. Happy to talk it through on a call tomorrow if that's easier.
Sam
note: No three paragraphs before the news. If she's upset, don't defend; restate the two options and let her choose.

situation: Borrowed my friend Nick's car for the weekend and scraped the passenger door reversing out of a parking space. My fault entirely. He only got it back from the garage last month.
reply: Nick, I've got some news you won't love: I scraped the passenger door of your car reversing out of the Tesco car park this afternoon. There's a scratch about a hand's width long and a small dent, photos attached. I'm really sorry, I know you only just got it back from the garage. I'll pay for the repair in full, at whichever garage you trust, and I can drop it there myself. Call me tonight if you want to talk it through.
note: When it's your fault, say it plainly with no excuse, and offer to pay before he has to ask.

situation: 我和室友小周合租两年了，合同明年1月15号到期。我决定到期不续了，要搬去和男朋友住，她得自己找新室友或者换房子。她挺喜欢这套房子的。
reply: 小周，有件事想早点告诉你，可能不是你想听的：1月15号合同到期后，我不打算续租了，要搬去和男朋友一起住。我知道这样你得重新找室友或者换房，挺折腾的，所以提前三个多月跟你说。找室友我可以帮你发朋友圈、一起见人，跟房东交接押金的事也我来跑。今晚回来我们当面聊聊？
note: 消息放在前两句，承认对她的影响，再给具体的帮忙；大事发完消息还要当面聊。
